text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик shuts Огури Кэп out with a
tenacious
run, seizing the victory for
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик has won race after race
intent on
earning me the title of "best
trainer in the world."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to make this dream a reality, the
next
race she chooses to run in is... the
Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
